title: A gate whose question names a credential as a lower-case snake_case identifier outside the closed credential-part list (registration_token, ci_job_token, vault_token) is classed design, not secrets
goal: a gate whose question names registration_token, ci_job_token, vault_token, trigger_token or another credential token as a snake_case identifier is classed secrets, while bare_token and def_tokens stay classed by their other words

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_authority as a;bad=[q for q in ("Should the worker print the registration_token in the log?","Do we rotate the vault_token each week?","Should the ci_job_token reach the job env?") if a.class_reasons({"touches":["_tools/x.py"]},{"id":"g1","question":q,"options":["one","two"]})[0]!="secrets"];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import bl_authority as a
def cl(q,t=None):return a.class_reasons({"touches":t or []},{"id":"g1","question":q,"options":["one","two"]})[0]
cred=[q for q in ("Should the worker print the registration_token in the log?","Do we rotate the vault_token each week?","Should the ci_job_token reach the job env?","Is the trigger_token kept in the project settings?","Does the webhook_tokens list reach the log?") if cl(q)!="secrets"]
real=[q for q in ("Rotate the API token of the service account?","Where is the GITLAB_TOKEN kept?","Store the credential file in _private?","Should the secret be kept in a vault?") if cl(q)!="secrets"]
ident=[q for q in ("Gate and bare_token move to ql_learn; def_tokens is left with no caller","Does the helper bare_token stay in kbcommon?","Does read_token keep its signature?") if cl(q)=="secrets"]
counts=[q for q in ("Show tokens per correct answer in the report?","Sum input, output and cache tokens in the multi table?","Is a token budget per run kept in the report?","Show cache tokens beside the input tokens?") if cl(q,["_tools/bench_report.py"])=="secrets"]
mod=[q for q in ("Use tokenize.generate_tokens to find comments?","Does tokenize.tokenize(f.readline) read bytes?","Keep tokenize.TokenInfo in the scan?") if cl(q,["_tools/bl_check.py"])=="secrets"]
print("credential identifiers not secrets:",cred,"| real:",real,"| code identifiers secrets:",ident,counts,mod)
sys.exit(1 if cred or real or ident or counts or mod else 0)

notes: Planner 2026-10-26: repro and check 0 fail on main (4 of the 5 planted credential identifiers class design). Design decided in the plan, no open choice: SNAKE_TOKEN_IDENT blanks a lower-case snake_case identifier ending in token or tokens only when every part before the ending is on a closed list of code words (bare, def, read: the shapes the BG-sqmvvtiy comment names); any other part, a credential, secret or service part included, keeps the secrets class, so the rule fails closed. The model token counts (output_tokens, token counts) and tokenize.NAME stay handled by TOKEN_COUNT and TOKENIZE_ATTR, which run beside it; check 0 holds the planted cases of BG-sqmvvtiy, BG-ohawboem and BG-dry4luf6. Docs: backlog.md and tools.md name the identifier rule and are updated in the item. Pre-approved by the operator for the 2026-10-26 run. The check "tests.py _tools/test_authority.py" passes before the work by design: it guards the critical component's existing tests (no new test; the planted check 0 is the one that fails on main).
